# /home/isa/.config/systemd/user/pocketlore-modern-emulator.service
[Unit]
Description=PocketLore Android 17 Pixel 10 Pro visual and compatibility emulator
[Service]
Environment=DISPLAY=:0
Environment=WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
Environment=XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
Type=simple
Environment=ANDROID_HOME=/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/sdk
Environment=ANDROID_USER_HOME=/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/user
Environment=ANDROID_AVD_HOME=/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/user/avd
ExecStart=/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/sdk/emulator/emulator -avd pocketlore_pixel10pro_api37 -port 5564 -no-window -no-audio -no-snapshot -no-boot-anim -gpu host -memory 11264 -cores 4
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
MemoryMax=14G
CPUQuota=400%
TasksMax=512
StandardOutput=append:/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/emulator.log
StandardError=append:/home/isa/PocketLore-control/runtime/modern-android/emulator.log
[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

# /home/isa/.config/systemd/user/pocketlore-modern-emulator.service.d/overnight-bounded-recovery.conf
[Unit]
StartLimitIntervalSec=3600
StartLimitBurst=3
[Service]
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStopSec=25
